descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Comerț internațional și dezvoltare
Are you an organized, detail-oriented and proactive individual with strong communication skills?
 We are looking for a Commercial Assistant to join our team!
 Your Responsibilities: 
Manage the post-order process to ensure efficiency and reduce administrative burden, with a keen attention to detail.
Maintain strong relationships with suppliers and involved parties to facilitate smooth operations and avoid errors.
Ensure timely and accurate payment of supplier invoices, double-checking all documents and payments for correctness.
Monitor delivery timelines and resolve disputes related to transport or delivered goods.
Propose solutions for process improvements and effective dispute resolution, ensuring that all details are addressed.
 Your Qualifications: 
Excellent communication and time management skills with a focus on accuracy and attention to detail.
Team player with a proactive attitude and a keen eye for detail.
Fluency in French.
Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
 What do we offer: 
Initial training and periodic coaching specific to the job.
Real opportunities for career development in an international environment. Day off for your birthday.
Wellbeing activities, contests, sports, and competitions with various HR projects.
Benefit: an online benefits platform with a flexible budget that increases based on seniority in the company (meal vouchers, medical insurance, gym membership, holiday vouchers, etc.).
 Join us as a key player in our team in Brasov! If this sounds like your next opportunity, apply now!
